title: Adversarial Distilled Retrieval-Augmented Guarding Model for Online Malicious Intent Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on malicious intent detection and safety guardrails for LLMs. While it utilizes the 'Prosocial' and 'CounterfactualFair' datasets, which touch on ethical behaviors and fairness, its primary focus is on the technical robustness and efficiency of the model rather than investigating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks as a core component.
